Agreement for Water Bore Drilling &amp; Development 
 For 
 MALL 35 
 
 This Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the “ Agreement ”) is made and entered on 16 th day of July , 2020 (“ Effective Date ”) at Rawalpindi by and between: 
 
 Mudass a r Tanvir Khan , holder of CNIC No. 37405-9405306-1, sole proprietor operating under the name ‘ MS C orporation ’ with registered office at 25-Mobee Plaza Haider Road, Rawalpindi (hereinafter referred to as the “ Contractor ”) 
 AND 
 Mall 35 , a partnership firm, having its registered office at 94-B/1, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan through its authorized representative Fahad Arif Khawaja (the “ Employer ” which expression shall, where the context so permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns). 
 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 
 Whereas: 
 
 The Employer is constructing a shopping mall named and styled as ‘ Mall 35’ , located at Plot No.35-A, Police Station Road, Saddar, Rawalpindi Cantt. (the “ Site ”); 
 
 The Contractor is in the business of water boring and drilling works and has all the necessary skills, expertise, capabilities, training, equipment, permits and licences to carry out such works; and 
 
 Relying on the warranties and representations given by the Contractor , the Employer is desirous of availing and the Contractor has agreed to complete the water and drilling works at Site as more specifically defined in Appendix A of this Agreement (hereinafter called the " Works ") on the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSES AS FOLLOWS: 
 
 T erm and Scope 
 
 This Agreement shall come into force and effect on the 10 th day of March, 2020 and shall be valid for a period of thirty (30) days unless extended by the Parties in writing (“ Term ”). 
 
 The Employer hereby engages the Contractor , and the Contractor agrees to such en gagement , to carry out and complete the Works as more fully described in Scope of Works attached herewith as Annexure A and to perform and carry out all such ancillary acts and tasks as required and necessary thereto and the Contractor agrees to such engagement . 
 The Employer shall nominate a team of technical advisors and/or experts at its sole discretion (the “ Engineer ”) to supervise, corroborate and authorize the Works done at the Site and any decision/direction issued by the Engineer, shall be binding on the Contractor. 
 
 Water and e lectricity required for the completion of the Works will be provided by the Employer at its own cost and expense . 
 
 Contract Price and Payment 
 
 As consideration for the completion of Works, the Employer shall pay to the Contractor a sum of Rs. 2 , 149,923 ( Rupees Two Million One Hundred Forty- Nine Thousand Nine Hundred Twenty -Three ) inclusive of all taxes (the “ Contract Price ”). The Contract Price is the full and final consideration for the completion of Works and remedying of defects under this Agreement and no further payment or consideration of any kind is payable for the Works or remedying of any defect therein. 
 
 The Contract Price shall be paid by the Employer to the Contractor on the basis of completion of milestones as set out below : 
 
 Percentage of the Contract Price 
 Milestone 
 10 
 Signing of the Agreement 
 3 0 
 Mobilization of Work at Site 
 20 
 Completion of trial bore 
 20 
 Completion of Work 
 
 Any material or items required by the Contractor for the completion of the Works shall be payable by the Employer at the rates specified in the Item Rate List attached as Annexure B of the Agreement. Any and all items used will be charged as per the actual work done by the Contractor depending upon inter alia actual bore depth , the screen requirements and availability of water strata formations available on Site. 
 
 Representations and Warranties 
 
 Without prejudice to any other warranties and representations expressed elsewhere in the Agreement , the Contractor represents and warrants to the Employer the following : 
 
 That the Contractor shall comply with all laws, rules and regulations, whether local, regional or national which are applicable to any work related to or connected with performance of this Agreement, including the applicable labour law of Pakistan. 
 
 The Contractor and its personnel, employees, agents and sub-contractors have sufficient skill, training, experience, technical know-how, capacity and resources including machinery, equipment, vehicles, etc., necessary for the effective performance of its obligations under this Agreement to the satisfaction of the Employer . 
 
 All necessary consents, approvals, licenses, permits authorizations in connection with the works including but not limited to those from any governmental or regulatory body, agency, department, commission, board, bureau or other authority, or such other persons, as the case may be, have been sought and obtained or will be sought, obtained and maintained, by the Contractor at its own cost and expense, from the relevant authorities. 
 
 The Contractor is in complete compliance with all permits/licenses, including temporary permits/licenses, to provide services etc. of the nature and type under this Agreement; and is in complete compliance with all laws, rules and regulations of federal, state or local entities which may have jurisdiction over the Contractor such that any failure of compliance will not have an adverse effect on the Contractor’s ability to enter, execute, deliver or consummate this Agreement. 
 
 The Contractor has reviewed all documents, data, information provided by the Employer and has also inspected and examined the Site and its surroundings and has satisfied himself (having regard to considerations of cost and time) as to the form and nature of the Site and all other conditions of the Site that may affect the Contractor’s execution of the Works and its obligations under the Agreement. The Contractor therefore hereby accepts all responsibility for having properly evaluated all costs and contingencies for successfully executing the Works and satisfying all obligations under the Agreement and to bear all and any consequences resulting from its improper evaluation or interpretation. The Contractor undertakes to make no claims whatsoever or requests for variations, for price adjustments and/or time extensions based on its failure to sufficiently acquaint itself with the above-mentioned conditions and information. 
 
 That the Contractor shall bear costs and expenses for any damage caused to the existing public utilities and connections, including inter alia water, electricity, sui-gas, telecommunication lines and sewerage, during the Term of this Agreement . 
 
 The Contractor and the Contractor’s personnel have the sufficient skill, training, experience, technical know-how, capacity and resources including machinery, equipment, vehicles, etc., necessary for the effective performance of its obligations under this Agreement to the satisfaction of the Employer. 
 
 The Contractor and the Contractor’s personnel shall ensure that the W ork is conducted in a cost-efficient manner, th r ough , inter alia , effective deployment and use of men and materials. 
 
 The Contractor shall be responsible for health and safety of the Contractor’s personnel and labour at the Site throughout the period of the Contract and shall comply with all the applicable requirements and standards regarding the health and safety . 
 
 The material, machinery, vehicles, equipment and the Work is of satisfactory quality and fit and suitable for the intended purpose and can be used without any problem at the Site. 
 
 Termination 
 The Agreement may be terminated by the Employer at any time by giving the Contractor three (3) days ’ notice. Without prejudice to any rights or remedies available to the Employer under this Agreement or otherwise, if the Contractor delays or suspends Works for a duration of seven (7) consecutive days, in is found in breach of its obligations or representations under this Agreement, fails to rectify any defective Works, or performs Works in an unprofessional or otherwise improper manner, the Employer may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect without prior notice. 
 
 General 
 
 Latent Defects : In the event of any latent defect arising out of or connection with the Works, at any time but not later than one (1) year after the expiry of this Agreement, for which the Contractor is proven responsible, the Contractor shall be liable for removing any such defects in the Works and accordingly be liable for damage and loss caused or suffered by the Employer due to such defects . 
 
 Indemnity : The Contractor hereby fully indemnif ies , and shall hold harmless and defend the Employer , its directors, officers, employees, agents and representatives from and against any and all claims, demands, actions, suits, proceedings, liabilities, losses, settlements, judgments, damages, costs and expenses etc. (including but not limited to reasonable attorney’s fees and costs), whether or not involving a third party claim, which arise s out of or in relat ion to : ( i ) death, injury, permanent or temporary disablement to any person (s) , (ii) loss of or damage to any property, which may arise out of or in consequence of the execution and completion of the Works, (iii) breach of any representation or warranty of the Contractor as contained herein, and (iv) or as a result of its failure to fulfi l l its obligations or breach its obligations hereunder or otherwise owed to the Employer . 
 
 Force Majeure : Any delay in or failure of performance by either party of its obligations under this Agreement shall not constitute a breach or give rise to a claim of damages if and to the extent that it is caused by an occurrence or circumstances beyond the control of the Party, including but not limited to acts of God, natural disasters such as fire, hurricane, flood, earthquake, pandemics, strikes, lock outs, civil commotion, war, governmental or any public body action, or policy or any other cause that cannot be controlled by the Parties (" Force Majeure "). Affected Party shall inform the other through a written notice of such Force Majeure event within fifteen (15) days of its occurrence or their knowledge of its occurrence, even if imminent, whichever is earlier. In case Force Majeure continues for longer than twenty (20) days, the Parties may terminate the Agreement. 
 
 Governing Law and Dispute Resolution : The Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to this Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan, with the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Lahore. Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to this Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within five (5) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to arbitration, on the notice of either Party. Arbitration shall be conducted in accordance with the Arbitration Act, 1940. The language of arbitration shall be English and the seat of arbitration shall be Lahore. The award of arbitration shall be final and binding on both the Parties. 
 
 Confidentiality : The existence and the terms and conditions of this Agreement and any oral or written information disclosed by the Employer in connection with the preparation and/or performance of this Agreement shall be regarded as confidential information by the Contractor. The Contractor including its employees, executives, directors, representatives and agents shall take all reasonable measures to maintain the confidentiality of all such confidential information and shall not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties without obtaining the written consent of the Employer , except where such disclosure is required under the law. This clause shall survive the termination or expiry of this Agreement. 
 
 Severability : The provisions of this Agreement are severable. If any one or more provisions of this Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall substitute the affected provisions in such a way that to the maximum extent possible the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question. 
 
 Entire Agreement : This Agreement and its annexures and any other documents inferred herein constitute the entire agreement and understanding between the Parties with respect to the subject matter contained in this Agreement and supersedes and overrides all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, written or oral, between the Parties. 
 
 Counterparts : The Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Agreement. 
 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have signed the Agreement, having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.

 SCHEDULE A 
 Scope of Work 
 
 The scope of Work of the Contractor includes, inter alia, the following: 
 Drilling of t rial bore, 
 Electrical/geophysical logging, 
 Reaming/ e nlargement of b ore, 
 Design of PVC casing &amp; f ilter, 
 Supply &amp; installation of PVC bore casing &amp; complete development of w ater bore including but not limited to bore development using air lift method, pouring of pan crush, provision of bell plug, proper jointing of PVC pipe casing, 
 Provision of complete g eophysical report, etc. , 
 PVC Casing of E-Class from Newtech /Alpha make or e quivalent source (to be approved by the Employer), 
 Submission of m aterial s t est r eports, 
 S pecifications of c asing from s ources conforming to E-Class PVC pipe standards ; and 
 Other related and ancillary works.
